facts.title: 100 个可直接复制的 React 动效组件 — Motion Lexicon
facts.description: 为产品界面、媒体叙事和空间视觉准备的完整实现。

research.name: Motion Lexicon
research.note: 100 copy-ready React motion components organized by motion feeling and product job, with runtime cost labels and an agent skill.

effects: Dither reveal card: a pixel-dither threshold advances so the image develops with texture
Components tagged by scene (product mono, editorial warm, spatial dark) and runtime cost
Agent UI motion set such as thinking trace, tool call stack and multi-agent handoff

unverified: The source is public at github.com/Ryan-yang125/motion-lexicon (MIT, 50 stars); that repository has not yet been researched as a repo candidate.
The 2026-08-19 date is the v6 release commit; the repository shows a later push on 2026-10-21 whose content was not inspected.
